## Implementation

### Part 1: Reduce ci-llm-review-runner.sh to shim
Replace 429-line ci-llm-review-runner.sh with a ≤50-line shim:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ci-llm-review-runner.sh — shim: resolves _PLUGIN_ROOT, delegates to python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner
set -euo pipefail
_PLUGIN_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)}"
# Resolve python3 from plugin venv or system
PYTHON="${PYTHON:-python3}"
export DSO_CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER="${DSO_CI_REVIEW_PROVIDER:-${model_provider:-anthropic}}"
# Pass through overlay flags as env vars
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --overlay-security)     export DSO_CI_REVIEW_OVERLAY_SECURITY=1; shift ;;
    --overlay-performance)  export DSO_CI_REVIEW_OVERLAY_PERFORMANCE=1; shift ;;
    --overlay-test-quality) export DSO_CI_REVIEW_OVERLAY_TEST_QUALITY=1; shift ;;
    *) echo "ERROR: Unknown flag: $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
done
exec "$PYTHON" -m dso_ci_review.runner
```

### Part 2: Delete llm-api-call.sh
rm plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh

### Part 3: Update test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
Update to test the shim behavior (delegates to python module), not the bash runner logic.
Key tests to preserve:
- exits 1 when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty
- exits 1 for unrecognized flags
- exits 0 for empty diff
- exits 0 when review passes

### Part 4: Update ci.yml (already calls ci-llm-review-runner.sh — no change needed)
Verify ci.yml still works with the shim.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ci-llm-review-runner.sh is ≤50 lines

- [ ] llm-api-call.sh deleted

- [ ] Lint passes (ruff for any Python touched)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/ 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] shim exits 1 on unknown flag
  Verify: echo "" | bash plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh --unknown-flag 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 1
